key_insight: Sparse neural networks identify compact hyperelastic strain-energy models while exposing individual invariant contributions and their interactions.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports interpretable material-model identification for solid mechanics simulations.
method: Represent strain-energy density as a sum of products of univariate functions of invariants.
Apply sparsity-promoting constraints and regularization to retain few active modes.
Identify constitutive models in supervised and unsupervised learning settings.
evidence_signal: Synthetic-data demonstrations in both learning settings show accurate, interpretable constitutive models with few active modes.
watch_item: Validation on noisy experimental data and generalization beyond the tested loading conditions remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Sparse Constitutive Neural Networks for Hyperelasticity
